verdict.rationale: Neon provides a documented, keylessly-runnable CLI (verified via npx running without an account), a full Management API with API keys/OpenAPI spec, neon.ts config plus @neon/config-runtime for calling the same plan/apply logic from scripts or CI, and CLI subcommands (init -y --agent, claim, mcp) explicitly designed for unattended/automated setup. This directly supports headless/CI automation workflows. missing for 10: no explicit third-party CI pipeline (e.g. GitHub Actions) walkthrough or independent report confirming CI usage in production beyond first-party docs and probes.
